title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: The failure is in the Sentry .NET SDK's SourceGenerators analyzer package and its compatibility with Visual Studio 2019/Roslyn. It is not a Sentry SaaS product issue, so the SDK repository is the appropriate owner.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure is in event storage/query/display: opening an event whose timestamp becomes ClickHouse's maximum date causes the Sentry UI/API to return HTTP 500. No SDK-specific behavior or clear ownership transfer is indicated.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: The issue is a server-side bug in the global relocation import implementation, specifically ProjectKey.write_relocation_import. It is not an SDK or deployment-repository issue, so it should remain in getsentry/sentry.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: The issue is explicitly reported against a self-hosted deployment, and the failure occurs while configuring a repository integration. A closely matching confirmed transfer for adding an Azure DevOps repository was routed to getsentry/self-hosted, supporting the same repository boundary for self-hosted setup failures.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: The issue provides a specific Sentry taskbroker/Kafka producer defect: taskworker topics appear to bypass configured topic overrides, causing authorization failures and blocked ingestion-related task processing. The suspected implementation is in Sentry taskworker/Arroyo integration, not an SDK or deployment-only problem.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
